prose: BlastLoop is a coding method for AI agents by Ross Shaw. Three levels of agent, Blast, Mid and Inner, write code at different altitudes, then three test passes run in order: structural, bug and ops, and adversarial.
The pitch is that agents speed teams up but also make engineering failures arrive faster, so structure comes first.
highlights: Three code-writing levels followed by three test tiers.
Aimed at catching failures that AI speed amplifies.
